commentary_segments.text: A class-AB output stage can also be biased by translinear circuits, as explained previously. A translinear loop is a circuit which provides a linear relationship by use of nonlinear circuits. The simplest example is a current mirror. Both transistors have a nonlinear current-voltage relationship and yet the current gain is perfectly linear. The voltage between the two transistors is heavily distorted though.
